title: Vision Transformer
subtitle: Five questions turn one photograph into tokens, context and an ImageNet prediction.
audience: Students who have completed Transformers beyond next-token prediction (encoders, decoders and cross-attention).
durationLabel: 54 conceptual slides · optional labs available separately
hook: An encoder expects vectors. How can an image supply them?

sections.title: The question we want to answer
How can an image become a token sequence?
How does the model know where a patch came from?
We have 196 rows. Which one should we read?
How do the patches exchange information?
What does the model predict, and what changes its answer?
What have we built, and what is still missing?
